title: Nectar de tamarin (Tamarind Drink)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: A kilogram of tamarind fruit soaked 10 minutes, macerated, filtered and boiled 20 minutes in 5 litres of water, cooled, sweetened to taste and kept cool.
longDesc: p. 73 of the October 2023 recipe book: 1 kg tamarind fruit, 3 kg sugar and 5 litres of water. The fruit is soaked 10 minutes to soften the pulp, macerated to separate the pulp from fibres and seeds, filtered through a fine white cloth or sieve, and the juice boiled 20 minutes, removed from the heat and cooled; sugar is stirred in to the desired taste; keep cool. The book calls the drink very rich in vitamins A and C and ‘an excellent laxative’ (unsourced). It notes extracting the pulp is delicate because the pulp is sticky. The diagram says ‘Cuisson (100°, 30 min)’ against 20 minutes in the text; recorded, not reconciled.
steps: Soak the fruit 10 minutes in drinking water to soften the pulp.
Macerate to separate the pulp from fibres and seeds.
Filter through a fine white cloth or sieve.
Boil 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and cool.
Stir in sugar to the desired taste.
chefTips: The printed note is that pulp extraction is delicate because the pulp is sticky.
Sugar is listed as 3 kg but the method says ‘to taste’.
The diagram says 100° for 30 minutes; the text says 20 minutes.
commonMistakes: Adding all 3 kg sugar without tasting.
Taking the laxative claim as established.
storage: Keep cool (‘conserver au frais’). No shelf life is printed.
healthBenefits: The book’s description claims vitamins A and C and a laxative effect; it cites no evidence.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Nectar de tamarin’ (p. 73). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 20 is a placeholder. TWO-PASS.
CONFLICTS (unreconciled): boil 20 minutes in the text vs ‘Cuisson (100°, 30min)’ in the diagram; sugar 3 kg in the list vs ‘to taste’ in the method. ABSENT: shelf life.
